about.title: About medAI
about.scopeBody: medAI covers USPSTF depression screening recommendations (Grade B) for the general adult population, pregnant and postpartum persons, and older adults. It also addresses suicide risk assessment as a separate clinical concern.
about.methodsBody: medAI uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with hybrid TF-IDF + BM25 search over 728 pre-processed chunks from official USPSTF documents. Section priors boost clinically important sections. A canonical Grade B force-include rule ensures the core recommendation is always present. LLM synthesis uses a multi-model cascade via OpenRouter.
about.limitationsBody: medAI is based on USPSTF guidelines current as of June 2023 and does not reflect real-time updates. It covers US guidelines only and may not apply to other healthcare systems. It is not a diagnostic tool and should not replace professional clinical judgment.
about.criteriaBody: Innovation: RAG pipeline with section priors and force-include rules. Safety: Multi-layer crisis detection in 6 languages, dosing refusal, confidence gating. Trust: Verbatim citations with inline PDF verification and full pipeline traceability.

phq9.title: PHQ-9 Depression Screener
phq9.subtitle: Patient Health Questionnaire-9 — For screening purposes only
phq9.disclaimer: This screener is for informational purposes only and does not constitute a diagnosis. Please consult a healthcare professional for clinical evaluation.
questions: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way
phq9.frequency: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by:
phq9.question9Note: ⚠️ If you answered anything other than "Not at all" for question 9, please contact a healthcare professional or call 988.
